summary: Removed Sand Springs tower in Preston County, WV; register entry, a 1942 postcard credit and a 2008 foundation photo caption are the only sources. No build or staffing history found.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower has been removed. A September 2008 photo caption describes a foundation. Listed Tower Gone on the county list.
facts.agency: State of West Virginia (administered by the state)

events.note: Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg.
Register page carries a 1942 postcard credited to Ron Kemnow. The caption does not say more.
A caption credits Brian Powell with a September 2008 photo of a foundation at the site.
Register says the tower has been removed. No year or method is given.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS detail page, the FFLOS county list and the e-WV encyclopedia article were usable. Two searches found nothing about the tower's construction, staffing or fires. The 1942 postcard and 2008 foundation photo are described by caption only; their image URLs were not captured, so no photos entry. Access is unknown and omitted. The register does not date the removal.
